No esperaba una charla, pero fui 100 veces y la cara de ojete de los playeros es notoria... de ponen aire de mala gana, no te limpian vidrios..sorprende el mal clima laboral..como socio del ACA les recomiendo escuchar a la gente y charlarlo con el personal... el buen trato es propina..me tratas mas y no te dejo nada

(Translated by Google)
I wasn't expecting a conversation, but I've been there 100 times and the gas station attendants' sour faces are obvious... they blow air conditioning reluctantly, they don't clean your windshield... the bad work environment is shocking... as an ACA member, I recommend listening to people and talking to the staff... good service is just a tip... treat me better and I won't leave you anything

reviews.comment:
El playero que me atendio a la.manana en plena tormenta frio y viento lo mas
Super amable  me cambio las escobillas que estaban rotas y todo eran cerca de las 8 am
Me dijo qje a las 9 am abria el local de ventas y los boxes llegue a las 10 me cambiaron lo que necesitaba solo que tuve mucha demora

(Translated by Google)
The attendant who helped me in the morning, in the middle of the cold and windy storm, was incredibly kind. He replaced my broken wiper blades and everything else; it was around 8 am. He told me the sales area and service bays would open at 9 am. I arrived at 10 am, and they replaced what I needed, but I had a long wait.
